meta.title: IntelCrop — Digitalization | Agricultural Intelligence | Agrifinance
meta.description: IntelCrop digitizes agricultural producers and connects their crop to credit, markets and technology through satellite data and artificial intelligence.

hero.headline: We make the value of farming visible.
hero.subcopy: We digitize agricultural producers and connect their crop — with real-time satellite data and artificial intelligence — to those who finance them, supply them, buy from them and support their development.

team.heading: Global technology. Local presence.
team.body: IntelCrop combines global precision-agriculture technology with a local team that works in the field alongside producers, and builds alliances with financial institutions, industry, academia and development organizations.
